Like all Red Lanterns, Atrocitus cannot remove his ring sem risking death. Unlike his fellow Red Lanterns, Atrocitus seems Imune to the ring’s tendency to inspire mindless rage in its bearer. The Luz of a Blue Lantern ring can help counteract these Efeitos, not that Atrocitus seems to care.

Red Lantern Corps Poder rings depend on the Habilidade of the wielders to feel rage. The maximum graduação of the ring’s Efeitos is equal to the user’s Fortitude graduação to reflect the being’s capacity for raw fury. Calming thoughts e hopeful feelings, such as those inspired by the Blue Lanterns, can cause the ring to fail.
